paragraphs.source_en: How to get rich without getting lucky.

units.source_en: How to get rich without getting lucky.

paragraphs.source_en: Making money is not a thing you do—it’s a skill you learn.

units.source_en: Making money is not a thing you do—it’s a skill you learn.

paragraphs.source_en: I like to think that if I lost all my money and you dropped me on a random street in any English-speaking country, within five or ten years I’d be wealthy again because it’s just a skillset I’ve developed that anyone can develop. [78] It’s not really about hard work. You can work in a restaurant eighty hours a week, and you’re not going to get rich. Getting rich is about knowing what to do, who to do it with, and when to do it. It is much more about understanding than purely hard work. Yes, hard work matters, and you can’t skimp on it. But it has to be directed in the right way. If you don’t know yet what you should work on, the most important thing is to figure it out. You should not grind at a lot of hard work until you figure out what you should be working on. I came up with the principles in my tweetstorm (below) for myself when I was really young, around thirteen or fourteen.

units.source_en: [77] How to Get Rich (Without Getting Lucky):

paragraphs.source_en: Seek wealth, not money or status. Wealth is having assets that earn while you sleep. Money is how we transfer time and wealth. Status is your place in the social hierarchy.

units.source_en: Seek wealth, not money or status.
Wealth is having assets that earn while you sleep.
Money is how we transfer time and wealth.
Status is your place in the social hierarchy.

paragraphs.source_en: Understand ethical wealth creation is possible. If you secretly despise wealth, it will elude you.

units.source_en: Understand ethical wealth creation is possible.
If you secretly despise wealth, it will elude you.

paragraphs.source_en: Ignore people playing status games. They gain status by attacking people playing wealth creation games.
